run.description: The command to run the benchmarks

mode.description:
The mode(s) to run the benchmarks in. Accepts a single value or a comma-separated list (e.g., "simulation,walltime").
The following modes are available:
- `simu

token.description: CodSpeed upload token. Only required for private repositories.

working-directory.description:
The directory where the `run` command will be executed.
Warning: if you use defaults.working-directory, you must still set this parameter.

runner-version.description: The version of the runner to use. Use 'latest' to automatically fetch the latest release version from GitHub, or specify a version like '3.5.0' or 'v3.5.0'.

instruments.description:

mongo-uri-env-name.description:

cache-instruments.description: Enable caching of instrument installations (like valgrind or perf) to speed up subsequent workflow runs. Set to 'false' to disable caching.

instruments-cache-dir.description: The directory to use for caching installations of instruments (like valgrind or perf). Defaults to `$HOME/.cache/codspeed-action`.

allow-empty.description: Allow the action to complete successfully even if no benchmarks were found or run. Set to 'true' to enable this behavior.

go-runner-version.description: The version of the go-runner to use (e.g., 1.0.0, 1.0.0-beta.1). If not specified, the latest version will be installed

config.description: Path to a CodSpeed configuration file (codspeed.yml). If not specified, the runner will look for a codspeed.yml file in the repository root.

skip-hash-check-warning.description: Suppress the warning emitted when hash verification is not available (e.g. when using 'latest', branch, or revision versions).
